art_direction: An inviting couch on a quiet evening. A fictional adult relaxes in the background while two independent normal phones stand side by side in the foreground on a small side table, both screen faces turned toward the viewer and recognizably separate. One shows a tiny ORIGINAL cartoon landscape with a cheerful orange sun, the other a DIFFERENT ORIGINAL cartoon of a blue cat in a green garden. Both screens are visual only: no text, labels, controls, brand or existing copyrighted characters. Silver and deep green cases. Warm lamplight, quiet lived-in room, clear visual hierarchy, light uncluttered lower area.

poster_copy.title: 两块屏幕，一起追剧
poster_copy.subtitle: 一台看一部，快乐不打架
